name: eureka-displaytypes-library
description: Upload one product photo and see it in every retail display type (folded, hung, stacked, on forms, on shelves), with one click.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html dist/ && cp -R public/. dist/ && esbuild src/app.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --outfile=dist/app.js
scripts.dev: mkdir -p dist && cp index.html dist/ && cp -R public/. dist/ && esbuild src/app.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/app.js --servedir=dist --serve=8766
